name: Morozov-SH-I Arms Gideon
description: Featuring fortified armor plating, special anti-rip protective padding and ample storage, the Morozov-SH is ready to overcome all kinds of adversity. After consulting with security professionals, RRS added a unique high protective collar and a lightweight inner lining; making the Morozov-SH both comfortable and a battlefield stalwart. The Gideon edition features a heavily worn teal finish with yellow accents and a signature red snake insignia.
